Subject: Re: PoC credits expired — possible short reactivation?

We finished a big run of evals last week and appear to have exhausted our sandbox credits before the team could consolidate results. The PoC is in final stretch but hiring delays pulled our SREs away — we couldn't finalize the integration.

Is there any possibility of a short-term credit reactivation (tokens or $) so the engineers can finish the last verification step? If possible, we'd like a 7–10 day window to validate and ship the demo to the execs.

I attached a small usage snapshot so you can see the runs that pushed us over. Appreciate any one-off help here — Novum is leaning toward Redwood but needs the demo to go through.

Thanks,
Peter

Short answer: yes, we can do a one-off bridging allowance while we validate internal approvals. We typically authorize short windows for customers in the final PoC stage. I cc'd Marissa on commercial so we have a point on pricing/next steps.

Can you confirm the account email that needs the top-up (is it dev@novum.ai or the billing contact)? Also, any sensitivity around the data or model outputs I should flag to Security/Trust?

Forwarding Novum's ask — Peter needs a short, time-limited top-up to finish a demo. Usage snapshot attached.

Suggested play: one-off bridging credit capped at $1,500 (or equivalent token allocation) with a 7-day expiry and a brief clause that this is non-recurring and contingent on moving to a paid tier if they push past the window. Finance/ops flags? Security noted no sensitive concerns in the snapshot.

Please approve or propose adjustments; Marissa will own follow-up messaging.

Thanks,
Vivek
